description: nhentai.net gallery page as the server sends it (impit path, no JS). #bigcontainer > #cover img.lazyload with the real cover in data-src and a 1x1 GIF data: URI in src (plus a <noscript> copy); #info > h1.title split into span.before / span.pretty / span.after, h2.title with the Japanese title, h3#gallery_id; section#tags with one .tag-container row per label (Parodies/Characters/Tags/Artists/Groups/Languages/Categories/Pages/Uploaded), entities as a.tag > span.name + span.count with abbreviated counts ("141K", "6K", "47"); Pages as a search link; Uploaded as time[datetime] with an absolute date. Noise: header nav linking /tags/ /artists/ /characters/ /parodies/ /groups/ (plural index pages), two ad zones (banner image + iframes), 24 page thumbnails (…/Nt.jpg), the "More Like This" block with five other galleries whose captions carry their own circles/artists and the same parody (one is by the same circle), an empty comment container, and the window._gallery JSON.parse("…\u0022…") blob in a script (the reader's data; it repeats the gallery's tags with types, including language/category). Unsure: whether comments are server-rendered (I believe nhentai fills #comment-container client-side from /api/gallery/<id>/comments, so it is empty here), the exact _n_app fields, and the ad zone markup.
